mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (school_id, subject_code_id, unit_code_id, level, grade, source, source_detail, problem_type, question_text, question_img_url, answer, explanation, hint, difficulty, estimated_time, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{schoolId}, #{subjectCodeId}, #{unitCodeId}, #{level}, #{grade}, #{source}, #{sourceDetail}, #{problemType}, #{questionText}, #{questionImgUrl}, #{answer}, #{explanation}, #{hint}, #{difficulty}, #{estimatedTime}, 1, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET subject_code_id = #{subjectCodeId}, unit_code_id = #{unitCodeId}, level = #{level}, grade = #{grade}, source = #{source}, source_detail = #{sourceDetail}, problem_type = #{problemType}, question_text = #{questionText}, answer = #{answer}, explanation = #{explanation}, hint = #{hint}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE problem_id = #{problemId}
UPDATE problems SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE problem_id = #{problemId}

mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pu.parent_code_id IS NULL THEN pu.code_name WHEN pu2.parent_code_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT(pu2.code_name, ' > ', pu.code_name) ELSE CONCAT(pu3.code_name, ' > ', pu2.code_name, ' > ', pu.code_name) END AS unitName, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pa.is_correct = 1 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS accuracy, COUNT(pa.attempt_id) AS attemptCount FROM problems p JOIN problem_attempts pa ON p.problem_id = pa.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes pu ON p.unit_code_id = pu.code_id LEFT JOIN system_codes pu2 ON pu.parent_code_id = pu2.code_id LEFT JOIN system_codes pu3 ON pu2.parent_code_id = pu3.code_id GROUP BY p.unit_code_id, unitName HAVING COUNT(pa.attempt_id) >= 1 ORDER BY accuracy ASC LIMIT 10
